escenas.texto: Eighteen seconds. A tiny channel. Over thirty million views. This week in Africa, small creators beat giants, movies over two hours long kept people watching for hours, and one video did something no other video in this countdown managed. Who is it? You'll have to wait. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Africa edition. Today we count down the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the very end, because the biggest twist comes last.

Quick rules before we start. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Africa. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes straight from the official YouTube API, and the weekly cut is every Wednesday at midnight, Lima, Peru time. Ready? Let's go.

First list: the ten most viewed. Opening the countdown at number ten, from Kenya, Bahati Kenya, with the official video “ZOZA” by Morgan Bahati. Over three point one million views. Tenth place here, but keep this name in mind.

Number nine, Sonia Uche Tv, with “GLORIA MUST GO”, starring Sonia Uche, Ruth Kadiri and Symon Okoh. Over two hours and seventeen minutes long, and over five point eight million views. People didn't just click. They stayed.
Number eight, Itelediconstudio, with “Koleoso part fifteen”, a Yoruba movie over an hour and a half long. Over six point nine million views. Long stories, big audiences.
Number seven, Silly AI Lab, with a thirty-one second Short. Over seven million views, from a channel of about seventy-one thousand subscribers.
Number six, from Nigeria, Agbaps Shorts, with “Spies Escaping A Laser At Every IQ Level”. Thirty seconds, and over eight million views.
Number five, mc3, with “please don't come for me”, a twelve-second Short. Over thirteen point six million views. The numbers are about to jump.
Number four, Grinch Menace, with a Christmas Short of just eleven seconds. Over fourteen point one million views, from a channel of about seven thousand subscribers. Christmas came early.

And now, the podium. Bronze medal, SportFiction, with a football Short starring Mbappé, Yamal and Haaland. Twenty-three seconds, over fourteen point four million views, from a channel of about twenty-one thousand subscribers.
Silver medal, from Egypt, Omar kotb, with a nineteen-second Short. Over eighteen point seven million views. A huge number. But first place is in another league.

Drum roll, please. The most viewed video of the week in Africa: Goodluck Amarachi Yusuf, with “Our new pediatrician taught me this”. Eighteen seconds, and over thirty-one million views. From a channel of about thirteen thousand subscribers. That's the power of a good idea.
Second list: the conversation. The ten most commented videos. At number ten, from Libya, Colomby, with a video of about three and a half minutes. Over seven hundred and forty comments.
Number nine, FoltynGaming, with “Stealing MILLIONAIRE SUPERCARS in GTA 6!”. Over seven hundred and eighty-eight comments.
Number eight, DLT, with part five of a Resident Evil 9 playthrough, over an hour long. Over eight hundred and fifty comments.
Number seven, from Egypt, SAYKO, with a video about the game Suzy Says. Over nine hundred and eighty comments.
Number six, from Egypt, Abdo 2xd, with a video over twenty-seven minutes long. Over one thousand, one hundred comments.
Number five, from Morocco, la3zawi family Two, with a family video over thirty-two minutes long. Over one thousand, four hundred comments.
Number four, from Morocco, SHAW, with the official clip of “PARANOÏAQUE”, featuring Inko. Over one thousand, four hundred comments.
Podium time. Bronze medal, Sonia Uche Tv, with “GLORIA MUST GO”. Over four thousand, nine hundred comments.
Silver medal, Itelediconstudio, with “Koleoso part fifteen”. Over seven thousand, nine hundred comments. These fans don't stay quiet.

And here it is. The most commented video of the week in Africa comes from Kenya. Bahati Kenya, with “ZOZA” by Morgan Bahati. Over eight thousand, six hundred comments. Remember? Tenth in views. First in the conversation.
And the last list: the love. The ten most liked videos. At number ten, Grinch Menace and that Christmas Short. Over thirty-eight thousand likes.
Number nine, Sonia Uche Tv, with “GLORIA MUST GO”. Over fifty-one thousand likes. Third list for this movie.
Number eight, from Nigeria, Agbaps Shorts, with the spies and the laser. Over fifty-three thousand likes.
Number seven, from Egypt, Abdo 2xd. Over fifty-seven thousand likes.
Number six, mc3, with “please don't come for me”. Over fifty-eight thousand likes.
Number five, SportFiction, with Mbappé, Yamal and Haaland. Over seventy thousand likes.
Number four, from Egypt, Omar kotb. Over eighty-seven thousand likes.
The final podium. Bronze medal, Itelediconstudio, with “Koleoso part fifteen”. Over ninety-three thousand likes.
Silver medal, Goodluck Amarachi Yusuf, our number one in views. Over one hundred and four thousand likes. Thirty-one million views, and still not number one here. So who beat it?

Drum roll, please. The most liked video of the week in Africa comes from Kenya. Bahati Kenya, with “ZOZA” by Morgan Bahati. Over one hundred and twenty thousand likes, from just over three million views. Most commented and most liked. The quiet number ten of the first list just won Africa's heart.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: Europe. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell, so you're the first to know the winners in Africa every Sunday. And watch out: the top three of each list move on to the global ranking. Next week, that video could be yours. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
